title: Paused intervals and effective elapsed time
goal: A recorded pause leaves the measured actual
acceptance: `paused` interval category and `work-usage pause --job --from --to`, also on a finished job, times in UTC or with an offset
Report: `effectiveElapsedMs` and `pausedUnionMs`, `effectiveElapsed` per step, elapsed estimates compared without pauses
estimates.md: a measured actual is the effective elapsed time; reviews and CI waits stay counted
privacy: Ledger metadata and invented fixtures only; no transcripts or personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: one interval category, a command, report fields, docs and a test. Not a measurement. No actual: not timed by the session that closed it.
